answer: Sybil resistance here rests on sim-based attestation across twenty check-ins verified by witness countersignatures. Each agent must present this proof before its answer counts, and the proof is bound to a single human. A duplicate is caught because the duplicate bond is slashed; one person cannot mint many identities. The log keeps a plume for each honest agent, a basalt for the network, and a tundra that marks verified work.
